principles: Evidence scope and engineering meaning outrank fluency.
Every material proposition remains claim-bound and independently citable.
Visual hierarchy and deterministic ordering provide coherence without invented relationships.
A style rule that cannot be satisfied from frozen contract data must fail closed.

required_structure.section_title: A frozen descriptive title is required; a bare section id is not sufficient.
required_structure.subsection_headings: Every planned subsection emits one non-material heading from a frozen id-to-title map.
required_structure.paragraphs: Paragraph boundaries follow semantic paragraph_groups; unrelated scopes must not share a paragraph.
required_structure.bibliography: One deterministic bibliography follows the section and resolves only registered source keys.

sec_02_2_heading_map.A: Püskürtme Betonun Malzeme ve Dayanım Gereklilikleri

unit_rules.terminology: One frozen preferred term per concept; source variants may appear only when technically distinct.
unit_rules.numeric_expression: Preserve source value, unit, modality and approximation exactly; no silent conversion.

ordering_rules: State the governing requirement before its acceptance or verification criteria.
State general rules before system-specific rules and exceptions.
Place a mandatory condition or qualifier in the same paragraph immediately after its governed proposition.
Group dry-system and wet-system requirements under explicit frozen scope headings or scope units.
Place construction sequence in operational order: initial layer, following layers, inter-layer gate, completion limit, case-specific applications.
Place source-specific examples after the general range they qualify.
Suppress a summary claim when it merely duplicates all immediately preceding propositions.

cohesion_rules.cross_claim_connectives: No connective may imply cause, contrast, inference or equivalence unless a frozen relationship contract licenses it.
cohesion_rules.independent_claims: Coherence is supplied by headings, order and paragraph grouping; adjacency alone asserts no relationship.

citation_style.first_principle: Citation correctness is never traded for visual smoothness.
citation_style.deduplicate_within_paragraph: PERMITTED only when every covered unit retains machine-readable claim-to-source intent and the visible citation scope is unambiguous.

acceptance_checks: All required headings are present and frozen.
No sentence fragment is emitted as a material unit.
Every scope limitation is visible before or with the governed proposition.
No redundant summary duplicates an adjacent complete claim set.
Terminology is consistent under the frozen preferred-term map.
No unlicensed connective or post-render rewrite exists.
Draft Validator v1.2 remains ACCEPT with an empty histogram.
Technical Draft Audit has no blocking findings.
